1479-2374-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2374-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

465-670-1619-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6153.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Vicious Battlerager from exile to the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

240-2511-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-3200-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

549-2388-6587-7012.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
549-2388-6587-7012.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

3713-4316-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-5231-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2750-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-2750-5457.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3227-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3227-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Peregrine Drake.
When Scrivener and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3227-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2478-2866-4659-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-4050-5220-6539.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

539-2438-3045-3293.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-2438-3045-3293.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-2438-3045-3293.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

2457-3000-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-4396-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-4396-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

2068-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing a creature.
Ashnod and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Spawning Pit's ability.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Repeat.

372-2239-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2239-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

790-4651-5919.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-4651-5919.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

1976-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

326-2667.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Witherbloom Pledgemage triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-3094-3775-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1651-3094-3775-4659.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Safana's ability.
Resolve the copy of Safana's ability, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1914-2034-2500-3003-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying at most {4}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.

220-2484-2615.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
220-2484-2615.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing thirteen damage to all creatures.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing thirteen damage to target opponent.

586-2451-3069-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate Priest of Gix's unearth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste and exiling it at end of turn or when it leaves the battlefield.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Both Priest of Gix's undying ability and Void Maw attempt to exile Priest of Gix when it would be put into your graveyard.
Choose to apply the Void Maw replacement effect, exiling Priest of Gix.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate Void Maw by putting Priest of Gix from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
